Due to scheduled summer vacation weeks, which are extenuating our already significant shortage of human resources, the Glen Central Laboratory is temporarily modifying its testing schedule which includes that of Lymphocyte Stimulation Tests. The test will now be performed once a month with a maximum of 5 patients per week until the regular schedule will resume during the week of Sept 11, 2022. The modified testing schedule is as follows:
Modified Schedule Reception of Specimen
Week of July 17, 2022 Specimen must be received IN LAB no later than 12h00 on Tuesday, July 19th
Week of August 7, 2022 Specimen must be received IN LAB no later than 12h00 on Tuesday, August 9th
Week of September 4, 2022 Specimen must be received IN LAB no later than 12h00 on Tuesday, September 6th
# Patients must be pre-booked for testing by contacting Client Services for Clinical Laboratories at 514-9341934 ext 35687. Patients that are not pre-booked will not be accepted and will not have their specimen analyzed. Should you have any questions, you can refer them to Dr. Brian Gilfix, Biochemist, or to Client Services for Clinical Laboratories at 514-934-1934. We thank you for your understanding and cooperation. Page 2 / 2
